description: This source file defines the `PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator` class responsible for managing the connection and communication with the PeekabooBridge host, including starting, stopping, and maintaining socket symlinks. It also defines an internal service class `OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices` that provides various services related to permissions, UI automation, window management, and other system interactions, likely for a macOS application integrating with Peekaboo automation framework.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinator class that manages the lifecycle and connection to the PeekabooBridge host, including socket management and security information retrieval.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: Provides various system and application services such as permissions, screen capture, UI automation, window management, etc., facilitating interaction with macOS automation and accessibility features.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the PeekabooBridge host connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the host connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the host connection if not already running.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Creates symbolic links for legacy socket paths.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink at a legacy socket path pointing to the current socket.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Retrieves the current code signing team identifier using Security framework APIs.
